# monotaur_api_key (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur API key by its ID. Note: the `key_value` attribute will always be empty because the API does not return the key value on read. The key value is only available immediately after the `monotaur_api_key` resource is created.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_api_key" "ci_bot_key" {
  id = "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the API key to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the API key was created.
- `created_by` (String) The identity that created this API key.
- `environment` (String) The environment this API key is associated with.
- `expires_at` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the API key expires, if set.
- `key_value` (String, Sensitive) Always empty in the data source — the API does not return the key value on read.
- `last_used_at` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the API key was last used.
- `name` (String) The name of the API key.
- `prefix` (String) A non-sensitive prefix of the API key value, useful for identification.
- `revoked_at` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the API key was revoked, if applicable.
- `revoked_by` (String) The identity that revoked this API key, if applicable.
- `service_account_id` (String) The ID of the service account that owns this API key.
